# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

## Hypothesis

The VWAP overnight grinder identified parameter combinations that improve the VWAP_CONTINUATION setup by optimizing entry conditions (VWAP reclaim/rejection combos). The top keeper shows isolated profitability on 5/01 (+$40.01) with zero P&L on other J days, suggesting potential to capture selective winner days without increasing loser-day losses. However, the extremely low edge_capture (40.01 vs. required 771 floor) indicates the signal is likely too weak or overfit to be meaningful.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when:  
- VWAP reclaim: Price crosses above VWAP after being below for ≥ lookback_bars (2) with body ≥ body_min_cents ($0.05)  
- VWAP rejection: Price crosses below VWAP after being above for ≥ lookback_bars (2) with body ≥ body_min_cents ($0.05)  
- Additional filters:  
  - vol_mult: 1.5 (volume ≥ 1.5× 20-bar average)  
  - proximity_dollars: 0.15 (price within $0.15 of VWAP)  
  - require_ribbon_agreement: true (EMA ribbon must align with trade direction)  
  - ribbon_min_spread_cents: 30.0 (EMA ribbon spread ≥ 30c)  
Exit logic: Standard VWAP_CONTINUATION management (chart-stop-primary, TP1 at +50% premium, runner, chandelier profit-lock at +5%/+10%).
